audience: website owners who track their sites with Fathom Analytics

useCases.title: Report pageviews for a date range
useCases.text: The AI runs a report on visits, uniques and pageviews over a date range, optionally grouped by date or field and filtered.

useCases.title: Count how often an event happened
useCases.text: The AI lists the events a site has tracked and reports how many times one event was completed in a date range.

useCases.title: Check live visitor counts, pages and referrers
useCases.text: The AI reads the live visitor total for a site. It can add the top pages and top referrers of those visitors.

useCases.title: Add, change or delete a milestone
useCases.text: The AI lists a site's milestones (dated notes on reports, such as a launch), and adds, renames, re-dates or deletes one.

useCases.title: Add a site or change its settings
useCases.text: The AI creates a site in the account, or changes a site's name, sharing, timezone or multi-domain setting.

useCases.title: Set or clear the currency of an event
useCases.text: The AI sets the currency of an event's value by event name, or clears it so the event uses the site's default again.
